notes.md: - **P. Anandacharlu:** first Andhra to be **INC President** – presided over the **Nagpur session (7th), 1891**.
- **Asom Gana Parishad:** launched at **Golaghat** on **14 October 1985**, after the Assam Accord; first president **Prafulla Kumar Mahanta** (AASU leader, later Chief Minister of Assam).
- **Shiromani Akali Dal:** formed on **14 December 1920** at Amritsar; first president **Sarmukh Singh Jhabal**.
- **YSR Telangana Party:** launched by **Y.S. Sharmila** in **Hyderabad** on **8 July 2021**; merged with the **Congress** in **January 2024**.

new.s: Under Article 324(2), who fixes the number of Election Commissioners other than the Chief Election Commissioner?
new.x: Article 324(2) provides for a CEC and such other Election Commissioners as the President may fix.
new.angle: U0337 notes gap: Art. 324(2) number of ECs -> President

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution lays down the qualifications for membership of Parliament?
new.x: Article 84 gives qualifications for Parliament; Article 102 gives disqualifications; 173 and 191 are the State versions.
new.angle: U0337 notes gap: Art. 84 qualifications

new.s: By whom are the members of the Rajya Sabha from the States elected?
o: Elected members of the State Legislative Assemblies
Members of the State Legislative Councils
All members of the Lok Sabha
new.x: Rajya Sabha members (Art. 80) are elected by elected MLAs through proportional representation by single transferable vote.
new.angle: U0337 #16 FPTP vs PR -> Rajya Sabha electorate (notes gap)

new.s: What is the minimum age to contest elections to Panchayats and Municipalities?
new.x: The minimum age to be a member of a Panchayat or Municipality is 21 years.
new.angle: U0337 notes gap: local body candidate age 21

new.s: How many Lok Sabha seats were filled in the first general election of 1951-52?

new.angle: U0337 #12 First general election -> seats (notes gap)

new.s: Who chaired the first Delimitation Commission, set up in 1952?
new.x: The 1952 Commission was chaired by Justice N. Chandrasekhara Aiyar; J.L. Kapur chaired the 1963 and 1973 Commissions.

new.s: Who headed the Delimitation Commission for Jammu and Kashmir, whose orders were issued in 2022?

new.s: What happened to the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026, which sought to raise the Lok Sabha ceiling to 850?
o: It was defeated in the Lok Sabha for want of a special majority
It was passed and ratified by half the States
It was referred to the Delimitation Commission
It was struck down by the Supreme Court
new.x: The Bill got 298 votes for and 230 against, short of the special majority, and was defeated in the Lok Sabha.
new.angle: U0337 #2 Delimitation 2026 -> 131st Amendment Bill fate (notes gap)

new.s: For how long did Article 334 originally provide reservation of seats for SCs and STs in the legislatures?

new.s: What is ECINET of the Election Commission of India?

An app for reporting Model Code violations
A network of observers for expenditure
A portal for filing election petitions

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a ground for declaring an election void under Section 100 of the RPA, 1951?
o: A corrupt practice by the candidate
The returned candidate was not qualified
The returned candidate won by a very small margin
new.x: Section 100 grounds are disqualification, corrupt practice, improper rejection of nomination and improper acceptance of votes affecting the result; a narrow margin is not a ground.
new.angle: U0337 #22 Sec. 100 grounds (notes gap)

new.s: In which case did the Supreme Court hold that hiding serious criminal cases vitiates a candidate's nomination?
o: Ramesh Dalal v Union of India
Lily Thomas v Union of India
Kuldip Nayar v Union of India
new.x: In Krishnamurthy v Sivakumar (2015) the Court held that concealing serious cases vitiates the nomination.
new.angle: U0338 #10 Disclosure of criminal antecedents -> case (notes gap)

new.s: According to ADR, about what share of political parties' funds in 2004-23 came from undisclosed sources?
